start_with: Confirm the room exists as the intended Named Location and is active in the correct hierarchy.
Confirm the check-in group is associated with that location.
Open the check-in Schedule Builder and confirm the group/location row is enabled for the selected schedule.
Confirm the kiosk is configured for the applicable rooms and scope.
Check whether the room is currently closed in Check-in Manager or Device Manager.
Check the soft and absolute thresholds and current count.
If a campus filter is active, confirm it has not excluded every location.
If the room was created recently, check the installed patch level and cache behavior before rebuilding the hierarchy.
branches.title: A Room Does Not Appear During Check-In
branches.when: A Room Does Not Appear During Check-In

start_with: Confirm that the schedule is active.
Confirm it represents the intended check-in time and category.
Confirm the check-in configuration and screen are the expected generation for the installed version.
Confirm the schedule has the required check-in timing configuration.
Confirm filters on the Schedule Builder or kiosk screen are not hiding it.
branches.title: A Schedule Does Not Appear In A Check-In Scheduling Screen
branches.when: A Schedule Does Not Appear In A Check-In Scheduling Screen

do_not_assume: Confirm an assignment actually exists; preferences alone do not create one.
start_with: Confirm scheduling is enabled on the Group Type.
Confirm the person belongs to the applicable schedulable group.
Confirm an assignment actually exists; preferences alone do not create one.
Check whether the assignment is accepted, declined, pending or marked unavailable.
Review the Group Type’s confirmation logic and whether it changed after assignments were created.
Review block settings that can hide actions or change their labels.
If a decline reason is expected, confirm the Group Type requires one.
branches.title: A Volunteer Cannot See, Accept Or Decline An Assignment
branches.when: A Volunteer Cannot See, Accept Or Decline An Assignment

start_with: Confirm the assignment and its schedule time.
Confirm the Group Type reminder communication and offset.
Check the group member’s reminder and communication preferences.
If no group member communication preference exists, inspect the person’s profile preference.
For SMS, confirm the provider configuration, SMS-enabled phone and SMS-capable System Communication.
For Outreach Toolbox, separately inspect the reminder job time and push delivery in the target mobile environment.
branches.title: A Volunteer Is Missing A Reminder
branches.when: A Volunteer Is Missing A Reminder

start_with: Identify whether the source is a volunteer Schedule Toolbox export or an Event Calendar feed.
For Schedule Toolbox, confirm the person has at least one confirmed assignment.
For an Event Calendar feed, confirm calendar access and examine calendar, campus, audience and date parameters.
Confirm the URL still contains the required `GetEventCalendarFeed.ashx` handler.
Compare the Rock calendar occurrence with the exported result.
If a downloaded `.ics` file was used, regenerate it after schedule changes.
Check the Rock version when Group Schedule ICS summaries are unclear; the summary-format fix shipped in v17.2.
branches.title: A Calendar File Or Feed Is Empty, Stale Or Missing Events
branches.when: A Calendar File Or Feed Is Empty, Stale Or Missing Events

do_not_assume: On pre-v19 systems, do not assume the v19 materialization model exists.
start_with: Confirm the installed Rock version.
On v19, inspect the generated `ScheduleDate` rows for the schedule.
Use those rows for date-based SQL or Lava rather than re-expanding the iCalendar rule.
If expected rows are absent, stop and verify generation behavior for the exact installed build.
On pre-v19 systems, do not assume the v19 materialization model exists.
branches.title: A Date-Based Query Misses Recurring Schedule Occurrences
branches.when: A Date-Based Query Misses Recurring Schedule Occurrences

start_with: Confirm the Room Management plugin is installed and identify its version.
Identify the reservation and its explicit calendar linkage.
Compare schedule, location and contact fields without modifying either record.
Determine which record is authoritative under local policy.
Review the recipe generation and schema assumptions before running a workflow or SQL.
Stop before synchronizing if ownership, linkage or compatibility is ambiguous.
branches.title: A Reservation And Calendar Event Do Not Match
branches.when: A Reservation And Calendar Event Do Not Match

do_not_assume: Do not attempt broad hierarchy rewrites until the exact invalid relationship is identified.
start_with: Check the installed Rock version and patch level.
Inspect the affected location’s parent relationship.
Check for a location set as its own parent or placed beneath one of its descendants.
Do not attempt broad hierarchy rewrites until the exact invalid relationship is identified.
If the installation predates the v18.3 fix, review the release path and correct the data through an approved, bounded process.
branches.title: The Named Location Tree Will Not Load
branches.when: The Named Location Tree Will Not Load

start_with: Confirm the installation is on an applicable v19 build.
Verify browser connectivity.
Confirm the expected Check-In Manager block version is loaded.
Review local check-in configuration.
Compare the roster state with the authoritative attendance state before asking operators to refresh or re-enter attendance.
branches.title: Check-In Manager Attendance Changes Do Not Update In Real Time
branches.when: Check-In Manager Attendance Changes Do Not Update In Real Time

entrypoint: Choose the branch whose symptom matches the user's task, then inspect the live records before making changes.
